checks.evidence: Dimensioned apartment subassemblies, fasteners, sash/rail/AC detail tooling exists; generated window optics separates two sliding glass leaves from the frame and interior backing instead of relying on one opaque window block.
Generated detail geometry has a non-razor-edge replacement pass.
Danchi master geometry has explicit LOD staging.
Root/trunk/branch/twig/leaf hierarchy tooling exists; tree anchors now also receive root-zone planting interfaces rather than remaining visually disconnected from the plaza/grass substrate.

Two-sided foliage optics and transmission shader are present. Cause-based low understory reuses the same thin-leaf optical model and supplies four renderer-distinct cross-faded LOD levels with density reduced toward pedestrian-pressure sources.

Weathering remains driven by rain/splash/drain/contact/UV context rather than arbitrary grime. The facade pass deletes the legacy WeatheringOverlays primitive-cube root and reconstructs grade splash, sill/downpipe runoff, balcony drip residue, sparse rail-fixing rust and AC drain residue as non-colliding source-anchored meshes; vegetation density likewise follows ordinary maintenance/foot-traffic pressure rather than random decoration.

PBR generation includes physical-scale infrastructure micro maps, metre-derived macro/detail base-ground layers, a two-scale non-metallic facade coating, physically separated dielectric glazing, dry non-metallic weathering residue materials, root-zone soil/precast tree-pit materials and transmitted-light understory foliage.

One deterministic midsummer solar model drives SummerSun, procedural sky sun reference, sky-derived ambient fill and default specular environment. Two 512px HDR local reflection probes use ViaScripting/NoTimeSlicing refresh and outdoor BlendProbesAndSkybox renderer policy.

Generated fallbacks remain replaceable by authored FBX/GLB art; facade optics explicitly skips when the danchi authored-art slot is active. Vegetation ecology keys from stable tree-slot anchors, so authored tree replacement does not require moving the surrounding root-zone interface.

Per-component manufacture/material/angular-light-response registry exists, with explicit foundation/grade, facade/glazing, environment, facade-weathering and vegetation-ecology contracts. The ecology contract records establishment, dimensions, materials/finish, rooting/mounting, interfaces, exposure, ordinary aging, geometry-vs-material split, LOD policy, angular/Fresnel response and automatic fail conditions.

Dedicated 3840x2160 hero/oblique/grazing capture code with pixel-exact 100% crops rebuilds and saves the detailed benchmark before capture. Scene-save gates make non-primitive facade weathering and vegetation ecology persisted invariants whenever the required detailed geometry exists. The final scene reopen still re-validates lighting and refreshes realtime probes immediately before capture.

Capture contract records exact view/crop paths plus intended sky/reflection state and explicitly remains unrendered until Unity executes it. Vegetation review is targeted at oblique/vegetation_grounding, grazing/tree_shadow_contact and hero/ground_contact.
No actual Unity 6.3 editor/runner compile verification artifact exists yet.

expectedVisualScoreImpact: Vegetation/natural complexity: the six tree anchors gain a second vertical stratum of sparse low plants with per-tree density variation and a pedestrian-pressure gradient instead of uniformly clean tree bases.

Geometry/construction fidelity: four trees that intersect the apartment plaza receive explicit maintained planting openings with a recessed soil disk and twelve real chamfered precast edging modules, reducing the risk of trunks appearing to grow directly through an uninterrupted paving slab.
Material/PBR physical plausibility: root-zone soil and concrete remain non-metallic and rough while low foliage uses the existing two-sided transmission shader rather than opaque green cards.
Temporal/LOD stability: understory is explicitly staged through LOD0/1/2/3 with renderer-count reduction and animated cross-fade rather than abrupt disappearance.

Period/scene authenticity: maintained paved tree pits plus sparse ordinary summer undergrowth are consistent with a lived-in residential-estate landscape without introducing damage/disaster narrative.
